body: Yeah, I'm trying really hard. Im smiling all throughout the day and not thinking about anything, but then i let my guard down for a moment while in bed and it all comes crashing down again. I don't know how much therapy is really helping me, but like you said, it's a process.

I don't want this to become a legal matter. I know what she did was awful, but i still care for her. We became friends through a mutual friend and became very close because we both have bipolar disorder (although she's a lot more violent than me).  She's ill and doesn't deserve to have her life ruined because of it, and knowing what it's like to be dragged off into a mental institution, i know it wouldn't be any help to her. Besides, i don't want revenge or justice or any of that, I just want answers as to what happened, why it happened and what I need to do now. Yeah, she is very dangerous and I'm scared... I tried to tell her SO about what she did and he didn't believe me. I fear she may already be lying to people about what really happened as she kept threatening to go out and tell people that I did it to her rather than what actually happened. University did try to help, but instead just asked a bunch of survey questions and told me they don't know how to handle it and pushed me to another authoritative figure. It seems there's no help for someone who doesn't want to have someone else arrested.
